title: Underground Antics
description: An Australian-hosted Minecraft Server, established in 2012.
body:
**Java & Bedrock compatible** — join today at play.undergroundantics.au

Our tight-knit community is friendly and welcoming to new players, with active staff always available via Discord. Features include multiple worlds (PvE survival and creative plots), player shops, custom quests and Simple Voice Chat support.

Server Rules:
- No griefing.
- No hacks or exploits.
- No spamming entities (e.g., eggs).
- Don't kill people or kill/steal pets (except where PvP is on).
- No verbal abuse or racially/sexually offensive language.
- No spamming, excessive use of capslock, or begging.
- No advertising.
